# Security policy

FSRCNNX-EXT is pre-release software. Security fixes target the latest commit on
`main`; no released version is currently supported.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ajccarlson/fsrcnnx-ext/security/advisories/new)
and include the affected commit, browser and operating system, reproduction
steps, and expected impact.

Use a regular GitHub issue for bugs that do not have a security or privacy
impact.
